#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;
const long long base = 3;

long long power(long long a, long long n) {
    long long res = 1;
    a %= MOD;
    while (n > 0) {
        if (n & 1) res = (res * a) % MOD;
        a = (a * a) % MOD;
        n >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

void shuffle(vector<long long>& arr, int length) {
    for (int i = 1, j = length / 2; i < length - 1; i++) {
        if (i < j) {
            long long temp = arr[i];
            arr[i] = arr[j];
            arr[j] = temp;
        }
        int k = length / 2;
        while (j >= k) {
            j -= k;
            k /= 2;
        }
        if (j < k) j += k;
    }
}

void fft(vector<long long>& arr, int length, int dir) {
    shuffle(arr, length);
    for (int h = 2; h <= length; h <<= 1) {
        long long wlen = power(base, (MOD - 1) / h);
        if (dir == -1) wlen = power(wlen, MOD - 2);
        for (int start = 0; start < length; start += h) {
            long long w = 1;
            for (int k = start; k < start + h / 2; k++) {
                long long u = arr[k];
                long long v = arr[k + h / 2] * w % MOD;
                arr[k] = (u + v) % MOD;
                arr[k + h / 2] = (u - v + MOD) % MOD;
                w = w * wlen % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    if (dir == -1) {
        long long inv = power(length, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            arr[i] = arr[i] * inv % MOD;
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    int len = 1;
    int halfN = n / 2;
    while (len < (9 * halfN + 1)) len <<= 1;
    vector<long long> arr(len, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        arr[x] = 1;
    }
    fft(arr, len, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        if (arr[i] != 0) {
            arr[i] = power(arr[i], halfN) % MOD;
        }
    }
    fft(arr, len, -1);
    long long totalSum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        totalSum = (totalSum + arr[i] * arr[i]) % MOD;
    }
    cout << totalSum << "\n";
    return 0;
}
